source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl, whole board (scripts/out/<date>/board.json, board_source.py rule)
methodology: Each row is a distinct time-limited Nashville window that is open as of the as_of timestamp and carries a real, parseable closing date. Windows the crawl could not verify, windows with no datable close, and windows that have already closed are excluded -- no date is ever invented. 'closes' is the last day to catch a run or the date of a one-off; 'days_left' is counted from the build date.

windows.blurb: Seasonal light show with the Peppermint Path, the Star Field and a 28-foot Pixel Pine.

windows.title: Handmade Pasta Making Class with Chef Taylor
windows.venue: Mary Louise's Social Club, Tempo by Hilton Nashville Downtown
windows.blurb: A hands-on pasta class led by Chef Taylor in a downtown hotel social club. A second date is listed.

windows.title: The Boy Band Brunch
windows.blurb: A one-day brunch built around boy band nostalgia. Tickets start at $39, so bring the friend who still knows every choreography break.

windows.title: Tipsy Turkey Pub Crawl
windows.blurb: A pre-Thanksgiving pub crawl through Printers Alley, starting mid-afternoon.

windows.title: North Pole Express Train Ride
windows.blurb: A train ride where Santa and his elves walk through every car to visit with passengers.

windows.title: The Pasta Club: Gnocchi Night
windows.blurb: A Sunday afternoon devoted to one thing, gnocchi, at a hotel studio space.

windows.title: No Small Endeavor: music and more
windows.blurb: Nashville's answer to Prairie Home Companion, mixing storytelling, thoughtful reflections and live music. This edition features Emmylou Harris.

windows.title: City Winery Tasting
windows.blurb: A month-long wine tasting at City Winery, listed as an exclusive. Tickets start at $39 and there are several weeks to fit it in.

windows.title: It's A Wonderful Life: A Live Radio Play
windows.blurb: The holiday classic told as a live radio play by Studio Tenn. A seasonal run, so worth pencilling in before December fills up.

windows.title: A Starlit Dinner Amongst The Stars
windows.blurb: A ticketed dinner set at the Parthenon, which is reason enough to book a table at it.

windows.title: Holly Jolly Holiday Bar
windows.blurb: A holiday-themed bar concept that runs through the end of the year. Tickets start at $22, a reasonable entry fee for seasonal cheer.

windows.title: NYE: Nashville's Big Bash
windows.blurb: HARDY, Little Big Town and the Red Clay Strays headline a free-form lineup to ring in the New Year. The park sits just north of the State Capitol.

windows.title: Christmas on the Cumberland
windows.blurb: A holiday season run in Clarksville stretching from late November into the new year.

windows.title: Apericena Experience
windows.blurb: An Italian aperitivo-and-dinner style experience from the sandwich shop, running all winter as an exclusive listing. Tickets start at $90.

windows.title: Pilgrimage Festival 2027
windows.blurb: The eclectic music festival returns after a one-year sabbatical. Lineup details are expected about three months ahead.
